name: pr-trust
description: Contributor trust checks for GitHub pull requests: a GitHub Action, plus tools to try rules on any PR and backtest them on a year of history.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/action/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/cli/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.mjs
